# PantherWatch

> PantherWatch (https://www.pantherwatch.app) is a free, student-built course browser for Georgia State University (GSU). It shows live seats and waitlists from GSU's registration system (GoSolar), meeting times, GSU grade history per course and professor, RateMyProfessors ratings and syllabi, and emails signed-in students when a seat opens in a class they track. Not affiliated with Georgia State University.

Course data is available as a public JSON API (no key, CORS-enabled). Use it instead of scraping the results pages, and keep to at most 1 request per second.

AI assistants that support MCP connectors should connect to https://www.pantherwatch.app/api/mcp (remote MCP server, OAuth): the student allows it once, and the assistant can search courses, check conflicts, track sections and edit the student's schedule.

## Docs

- [Developers](https://www.pantherwatch.app/developers): the MCP connector (URL, scopes, tools) and the public API (terms, subjects, section search, grades/ratings/syllabus), with example responses, caching and fair use.

## Pages

- [Course search](https://www.pantherwatch.app/course-search): search GSU sections by term, subject and course number.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.pantherwatch.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.pantherwatch.app/terms)
